Choose how you play.

Share a run.

Take turns, share money and items, and choose what to buy between rounds. Work together to finish the run.

How to play →

Finish the run first.

Each team plays at its own table with the same starting setup. The first table to complete the run wins. Everyone else can keep playing for their finishing place.

Race rules →

Get the highest score.

Each table gets the same number of shots, six by default. The highest score wins. Teams can have different numbers of players.

Score PvP rules →

Build your table together.

Buy balls, pick up snacks, and try new combinations between rounds.

Shop with your teammates.

Your table shares its money and items. Everyone readies up before the next round.
